=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:986-1043 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment fetch `comments?per_page=100` dropped `&direction=desc`, so it reads the oldest 100 comments. The selectors `.[-1]` and `| last` then pick from that window, and a newer failure comment on an issue with more than 100 comments falls outside it.
  WHY: The gate then waits the full inactivity timeout instead of failing fast. Severity disagreement: most reviewers said NIT and gemini said MAJOR, so the highest is used. minimax_minimax-m3 adds that the clarification-needed check now sees bot comments older than the newest five, and that Phase 2 at line 1246 still uses `direction=desc`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:993-1069 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `CLARIFY_FAILURE_LOOKUP_MISSES` is one global counter shared by the failure and cancelled comment IDs, and it is never reset.
  WHY: The documented "up to 3 times" retry is not per comment, so a later comment can be marked checked after a single miss and fall back to the inactivity timeout.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1060-1065 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The substring check on `CLARIFY_FAILURE_CHECKED_ID` is claimed to match "123" against "1234".
  WHY: Four other reviewers refuted this because the check pads both sides with spaces, so only whole tokens match.
- changelog.d/9223-release-gate-clarify-stall-diagnostics.md:4 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says the old 5-comment read missed any comment after the fifth because the list came back oldest first. The old read was `per_page=5&direction=desc`, which is newest first.
  WHY: The fragment misdescribes the pre-change behaviour to operators.
- changelog.d/9223-release-gate-clarify-stall-diagnostics.md:12 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says no GitHub API call is added while polling, but `capture_run_id "Clarif"` runs on the failure-comment path inside the poll loop (line 1062).
  WHY: Each call walks up to 10 pages of `actions/runs` five times, so the statement is inaccurate.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:985-986 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: jq `capture(...)` is not guarded with `?`, and `2>/dev/null || echo ""` swallows the error.
  WHY: A comment starting with the failure prefix but lacking a "Run: <id>" URL discards a legitimate failure comment in the same list.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1059-1067 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `capture_run_id "Clarif"` is called once per unchecked comment ID inside the poll loop, repeating an identical multi-page walk.
  WHY: A poll carrying both a failure and a cancelled comment issues up to 100 run-listing requests and blocks for at least 16 s.
- tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py:458-506 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The red `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` CI job was misdiagnosed. The `::error::[lint_pr_body_auto_close]` lines are expected fixture output from `test_main_exit_codes`, and the real failing step is not identified.
  WHY: The required checks stay red for a cause not mapped to any diff site, and a history rewrite would not turn them green.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Match a comment whose body starts with the failure prefix "whatever its author".
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml `clarify_failure_comment_run_id()` (lines 981-987)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Lines 982-984 restrict matching to OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR or `github-actions[bot]`, and tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py:235-238 asserts that an outsider's comment is ignored. All three note this is deliberate, documented hardening and not a missing deliverable.
- requirement: Add a regression test that runs the wait-clarify step against a fake gh, asserting that on a stall with a findable Clarify run the timeout error line contains that run's URL.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: Gemini says `test_timeout_names_found_clarify_run` only asserts a hardcoded URL matching the stub. Sonnet marks its own entry as met, because the test asserts the exact `::error::` line with `.../actions/runs/901`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:993, 1063-1067 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: One `CLARIFY_FAILURE_LOOKUP_MISSES` counter covers both the failure and cancelled comments and is never reset, although the comment and changelog say "at most 3 times".
  WHY: After three empty lookups in total, a later comment with a new run ID is marked checked after one miss. The gate then falls back to the inactivity timeout.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1042 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The fetch no longer passes `direction=desc`, so it reads the oldest 100 comments, and the jq takes `.[-1]` or `last`.
  WHY: This cannot happen in practice because a smoke issue has only a few comments, and the gate still ends at the timeout, which names the run.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: match a comment starting with the failure prefix, "whatever its author".
  Expected change site: `clarify_failure_comment_run_id` in test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Evidence of absence: The helper filters to trusted authors, and a test asserts an outsider's comment is ignored. This is deliberate hardening, not a missing deliverable. severity=NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: a regression test where a stall with a findable Clarify run puts that run's URL in the timeout error.
  Expected change site: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py
  Evidence of absence: None. This is met by `test_timeout_names_found_clarify_run` and `test_failure_comment_for_older_run_keeps_waiting_and_timeout_names_newest`. severity=NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 1
